name: og-renderer
milky_way_notes: Strategy (a) used: HTML element with absolute URL constructed from request origin (url.origin passed as baseUrl prop). SVG element was ruled out — Satori does not support it. Relative paths (e.g. /textures/milky-way-fallback.jpg) also fail in Satori ('Image source must be an absolute URL'). The baseUrl is threaded from the OG route through renderProfileImage/renderRecapImage to ConstellationOG, where it constructs the full URL: `${baseUrl}/textures/milky-way-fallback.jpg`.
bloom_notes: SVG <filter>/<feGaussianBlur> stacks were considered but SVG <text> and filter elements inside transformed <g> groups cause Satori layout errors. Instead, 4 concentric circles per star with decreasing opacity simulate the bloom glow effect (r*5@4%, r*2.5@10%, r*1.5@28%, r@95%). This is reliably rendered by Satori/resvg.
text_notes: Satori does not support SVG <text> nodes inside <svg> (throws 'not currently supported, please convert to <path>'). All text (cluster labels, star labels, watermark) is rendered as absolutely positioned HTML <div> elements with pixel positions computed from the viewBox-to-pixel mapping: scale = max(width/1000, height/700), px = tx + vx*scale.
test_mock_support: ?test=1 on both OG routes returns deterministic mock data (15 lit stars across 6 clusters) when NODE_ENV !== 'production'.
